portfolio-prioritization.summary: Beta should be the first reliability priority; its error-rate signal outweighs Alpha's healthier position.

findings.title: Beta is the first priority
findings.detail: Beta's health and error evidence indicate the clearest current risk.
findings.action: Inspect recent deploys and error logs before changing traffic or capacity.

findings.title: Alpha remains healthier
findings.detail: Alpha's deterministic health signal does not outrank Beta's reliability risk.
findings.action: Keep monitoring Alpha while the Beta investigation is active.

revenue-multi-currency.summary: USD and EUR MRR must be reviewed as separate currency movements.

findings.title: USD MRR movement
findings.detail: The USD series changed within the measured period.
findings.action: Review USD subscription changes and refunds.

findings.title: EUR MRR movement
findings.detail: The EUR series moved independently from USD.
findings.action: Review EUR customer and plan events separately.

seo-visibility-without-clicks.summary: Visibility increased, but clicks and CTR show that search exposure is not converting into visits.

findings.title: Impressions are not becoming clicks
findings.detail: Impression visibility and click evidence have diverged.
findings.action: Segment queries and pages to identify the largest CTR gaps.

findings.title: Test search presentation
findings.detail: The evidence supports inspecting query intent, not assuming an external cause.
findings.action: Rewrite the title and snippet for one high-impression query and measure CTR.

operations-regression.summary: Investigate the error-rate increase first and use CPU p99 as a correlated pressure signal, not a proven cause.

findings.title: Error rate is the first regression
findings.detail: The error signal is the clearest direct user-impact indicator.
findings.action: Compare deploy timing with logs and prepare a reversible rollback if confirmed.

findings.title: CPU p99 needs correlation
findings.detail: CPU pressure moved, but the evidence does not prove causation.
findings.action: Inspect CPU-heavy routes alongside request volume and error samples.

agency-client-brief.summary: The client has a conversion win, a search-click risk, and a focused next action while competitor evidence remains observational.

findings.title: Win: conversions improved
findings.detail: The measured conversion signal is the clearest positive outcome.
findings.action: Document the campaign and landing-page pattern associated with this period.

findings.title: Risk: search clicks need attention
findings.detail: Search clicks are the principal acquisition risk in the current evidence.
findings.action: Review losing queries and pages before the next client update.

findings.title: Next action: monitor the observed rival
findings.detail: The competitor signal is directional evidence only.
findings.action: Compare the rival's visible content topics with the client's query gaps.

cross-signal-hypothesis.summary: Revenue and sessions moved together, which supports an investigation hypothesis but does not prove causation.

findings.title: Hypothesis: acquisition may contribute to the revenue decline
findings.detail: The period shows revenue and sessions co-movement; this relationship is a prioritization signal, not causal proof.
findings.action: Validate the hypothesis by segmenting sessions and USD revenue by channel and conversion path, then run a bounded acquisition experiment.
